subject: general
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

Try harder, don’t __give away__ so easily.
solution:
The correct answer is: **give up**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given phrasal verbs.
 
• **Give back** means to return something to the person who gave it to you.
 
 
• **Example-** *The company had to **give back** all the money customers had paid.*
 
 
 
• **Give up** means to stop trying to do something; to accept that you cannot do something.
 
 
• **Example-** *She didn't **give up** work when she had the baby. *
 
 
 
• **Give out** means ​to come to an end; to be completely used up.
 
 
• **Example-** *After a month their food supplies **gave out**.*
 
 
 
• As per the meaning of the given phrasal verbs **'give up' **is the most suitable option.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

**Corrected sentence:** *Try harder, don’t give up__ so easily. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Give away **means to make known something that someone wants to keep secret.

 
 
• **Example-** *She **gave away **state secrets to the enemy.*
